# Lumen Learning Courses

> > Open educational resources platform providing LTI-integrated course content for colleges and universities through Canvas, Blackboard, and other learning management systems.

Lumen Learning delivers affordable, high-quality digital courseware to higher education institutions through LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) integrations. The platform partners with community colleges, state universities, and private institutions to provide accessible educational content that integrates seamlessly with existing learning management systems.

## Key Topics

- LTI Integration
- Canvas LMS
- Blackboard LMS
- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Community College Partnerships
- Learning Management Systems
- Educational Technology
- Course Content Platform
- Institutional Integrations
- Higher Education
- Digital Courseware
- LTI Consumer
- WordPress Platform
- Course Management
- Educational Accessibility

## LMS Platform Integrations

- [Lumen Learning Blackboard Coursesites](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/lumen-learning-blackboard-coursesites): Blackboard Coursesites LTI integration for Lumen Learning platform
- [Tidewater Community College Blackboard Production](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/tidewater-community-college-blackboard-production): Blackboard LTI integration for Tidewater Community College
- [Tacoma Community College Canvas](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/tacoma-community-college-canvas): Canvas LTI integration page for Tacoma Community College
- [Rappahannock Community College Canvas](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/rappahannock-community-college-rappahannock-community-college-canvas): Canvas LTI integration for Rappahannock Community College
- [Wytheville Community College Canvas](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/wytheville-community-college-wytheville-community-college-canvas): Canvas LTI integration for Wytheville Community College
